cases.name: an entry crediting itself counts as a pointer elsewhere
caught_by: a strike naming only its own entry credits nobody: problems: wanted 0, got 1 ['2026-09-19-an-entry.md: `It does not do the first thing.` is closed, and the strike beside it credits 2026-09-19-an-entry.md — which its `by` does not name. Describing the work is not citing it: a reader of the tracker has no way back to the entry that did it.']

cases.name: the by must name every credited entry, not any of them
cases.old: if not any(entry in says for entry in wanted):
cases.new: if not all(entry in says for entry in wanted):
caught_by: a `by` naming one of two credited entries is enough: problems: wanted 0, got 1 ['a.md: `It does not do the first thing.` is closed, and the strike beside it credits 2026-09-19-the-entry-that-started-it.md, 2026-09-20-the-entry-that-closed-it.md — which its `by` does not name. Describing the work is not citing it: a reader of the tracker has no way back to the entry that did it.']

cases.name: the credit pattern stops requiring a date, so any .md counts
